content:
Aisha: Heads-up — planning rollout tonight 09:00 PDT of serving runtime kernel v1.06 + new quant profile `qp-5` to gpu-pool-a and gpu-pool-b. Main goals: reduce mem and token cost for LlamaX while keeping p99 latency impact <10% :rocket:
Marco: I can take the deploy. ETA 20 minutes for canary then expand if green. Will coordinate with infra for capacity.
Jun: Smoke tests I want run post-canary:
- perf: p50/p95/p99 for 512-token seq (baseline attached)
- correctness: small eval set (10 prompts) against golden outputs
- kv-cache integrity check (no key collisions)
Leah: Rollback plan ready — if p99 > baseline * 1.2 or error-rate spike > 0.5% we revert to v1.05 and previous quant profile `qp-4`. Rollback steps in runbook.
Sam: Reminder: clear prefix cache on canary nodes after deploy: `rdwctl cache flush --pool gpu-pool-a --prefixes` . Also watch token/sec per instance to ensure batching unchanged.
ci-bot: build/artefact ready: `redwood-runtime:v1.06-qp5-2026-03-17` pushed to prod-registry. Canary image digest sha256:abc123.
Marco: Plan: 09:00 PDT -> deploy 5% canary (2 instances) gpu-pool-a. Wait 15m. If green -> 25% for 30m -> full. I will update this thread at each step.
Aisha: Add these dashboards to the watchlist: `runtime/p99_latency`, `runtime/error_rate`, `runtime/tokens_per_sec`, `model/quality/regressions`. Will have a quick call on +5m if anomalous :eyes:
Jun: Quick smoke commands:
```
# latency baseline check (run from infra-host)
curl -sS http://canary-host:8080/healthz && 
curl -sS -X POST http://canary-host:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"eval_prompts[0]","max_tokens":128}' | jq '.time_ms'
```
Leah: If rollback needed:
1) pause traffic routing to canary
2) trigger `redwood-deploy rollback --image redwood-runtime:v1.05-qp4-...`
3) run quick sanity (`/healthz` + 3 eval prompts)
4) open incident channel if rollback takes >10m
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window logged: 2026-03-17T16:00:00Z->2026-03-17T18:00:00Z. No customer-impact expected.
Marco: I'll ping on #eng-oncall before canary, and post the canary metrics here. Anyone want the 09:00 slot bumped to 09:30?
Aisha: Keep 09:00 — matches Asia overlap for infra. If any blocking, call me immediately.
Sam: Also note: quant profile change requires updated tensor core kernels — match list in release notes. If you see high small-batch latency, revert quant changes only (keep kernel) via feature flag `qp=qp-4`.
Jun: I'll automate eval run and post results here as a short table.
Marco: Great. I'll start the canary at 1749003600 (09:00 PDT). Will update thread: canary-up / canary-checks / promote / done or rollback. :thumbsup:
Aisha: Thanks — tagging @Leah @Jun @Sam for quick eyeballs during rollout.
Leah: :+1:
ci-bot: Canary started at 1749003600, instances: canary-01, canary-02. Deploy log: https://ci.internal/redwood/deploy/1749001234
Marco: canary-up — hitting endpoints now, running smoke.
Jun: smoke results (after 5m): p50 45ms, p95 210ms, p99 420ms (baseline p99 380ms) — slight uptick but within 10%. correctness pass 10/10. kv-cache checks OK.
Aisha: Looks acceptable. Marco, proceed to 25% when ready.
Marco: promoting to 25% now.
ops-bot: Alert watcher added for 30m: runtime/p99_latency > 1.15 * baseline.
Sam: Watching token/sec and batching distribution. No regressions so far.
Marco: 25% stable after 30m. Proceeding to full roll.
Leah: Noted — stand by for any rollback triggers during full roll.
ci-bot: Full promotion complete. image: redwood-runtime:v1.06-qp5-2026-03-17 deployed to gpu-pool-a,b.
Jun: Post-roll quick eval summary: p99 overall +8%, error-rate stable at 0.07%, quality hash unchanged for 100 eval prompts.
Aisha: Closing rollout — no rollback. Please file a short post-roll note in #eng-releases with perf numbers and update rollout doc. Thanks all :tada:
Marco: will open PR with metrics and update runbook with the qp-5 caveats.
Leah: copying rollback snippets into runbook now.
Aisha: :raised_hands:
